newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's TVA pay television group names new chief.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's TVA pay television group names new chief.

text.p: Brazilian pay television group TVA, a subsidiary of the Grupo Abril media conglomerate, said it had named Raul Rosenthal as its new president on Monday.
In a statement the company said Rosenthal, formerly Grupo Abril's executive vice-president, would seek to consolidate TVA's presence as a leading provider of pay television services.
Rosenthal, 48, fills a post left open by Claudio Dascal, who earlier this year was named Grupo Abril's vice president of telecommunications.

The statement said TVA ended 1996 with $198 million in revenues and over one million subscribers. TVA delivers pay television services in Brazil and Portugal using several systems including cable, C Band and Ku Band.
